def find_notebook(start_dir: Path, notebook_dir: str | None = None) -> Notebook:
    start_dir = start_dir.resolve()
    if notebook_dir:
        candidate = Path(notebook_dir)
        if not candidate.is_absolute():
            candidate = (start_dir / candidate).resolve()
        if (candidate / ".zk").is_dir():
            root = candidate
        elif candidate.name == ".zk" and candidate.is_dir():
            root = candidate.parent
        else:
            fail(
                f"failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {candidate} or a parent directory"
            )
    else:
        current = start_dir
        root = None
        while True:
            if (current / ".zk").is_dir():
                root = current
                break
            if current.parent == current:
                break
            current = current.parent
        if root is None:
            fail(
                f"failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {start_dir} or a parent directory"
            )
    config = load_config(root / CONFIG_FILE)
    state = load_state(root)
    return Notebook(root=root, config=config, state=state)


def notebook_link_format(config: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return (
        config.get("format", {})
        .get("markdown", {})
        .get("link-format", "wiki")
    )


def make_note_link(config: dict[str, Any], path: str, title: str) -> str:
    stem = strip_extension(path)
    fmt = notebook_link_format(config)
    if fmt == "markdown":
        label = title or Path(stem).name
        return f"[{label}]({stem})"
    if fmt == "wiki":
        return f"[[{stem}]]"
    return render_template(fmt, {"path": stem, "title": title})


def parse_tags(raw_content: str, config: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    markdown_cfg = config.get("format", {}).get("markdown", {})
    tags: list[str] = []
    if markdown_cfg.get("hashtags", True):
        for match in re.finditer(r"(?<![\w/])#([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_\-/]*)", raw_content):
            tags.append(match.group(1))
    if markdown_cfg.get("colon-tags", False):
        for match in re.finditer(r":([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+):", raw_content):
            tags.append(match.group(1))
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for tag in tags:
        if tag not in seen:
            seen.add(tag)
            result.append(tag)
    return result


def paragraph_for_offset(text: str, start: int, end: int) -> str:
    paragraphs = text.split("\n\n")
    cursor = 0
    for paragraph in paragraphs:
        para_end = cursor + len(paragraph)
        if cursor <= start <= para_end:
            return paragraph
        cursor = para_end + 2
    return text


def parse_links(raw_content: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, list[str], str, int, int]]:
    links: list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, list[str], str, int, int]] = []
    for match in re.finditer(r"\[\[([^\]]+)\]\]", raw_content):
        title = match.group(1)
        start, end = match.span()
        links.append(
            (
                title,
                title,
                "wiki-link",
                False,
                [],
                paragraph_for_offset(raw_content, start, end),
                start,
                end,
            )
        )
    for match in re.finditer(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)", raw_content):
        title = match.group(1)
        href = match.group(2)
        start, end = match.span()
        links.append(
            (
                title,
                href,
                "markdown-link",
                bool(re.match(r"[a-z]+://", href)),
                [],
                paragraph_for_offset(raw_content, start, end),
                start,
                end,
            )
        )
    return links


def first_heading_and_body(text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    lines = text.splitlines()
    title = ""
    start = 0
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("# "):
            title = stripped[2:].strip()
            start = index + 1
            break
    body = "\n".join(lines[start:]).lstrip("\n").rstrip("\n")
    return title, body


def lead_from_body(body: str) -> str:
    if not body:
        return ""
    return body.split("\n\n", 1)[0].strip()


def resolve_link_target(note_map: dict[str, Note], title_map: dict[str, Note], href: str, title: str) -> str | None:
    normalized = href.strip()
    candidates = [
        normalized,
        normalized + ".md",
        strip_extension(normalized),
    ]
    for candidate in candidates:
        for path, note in note_map.items():
            if path == candidate or strip_extension(path) == strip_extension(candidate):
                return note.path
    if title in title_map:
        return title_map[title].path
    return None


def scan_notes(notebook: Notebook) -> list[Note]:
    config = notebook.config
    note_cfg = config.get("note", {})
    extension = "." + str(note_cfg.get("extension", "md")).lstrip(".")
    previous = notebook.state.get("notes", {})
    notes: list[Note] = []
    for path in sorted(notebook.root.rglob(f"*{extension}")):
        if ".zk" in path.parts:
            continue
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        rel = path.relative_to(notebook.root).as_posix()
        raw = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        title, body = first_heading_and_body(raw)
        lead = lead_from_body(body)
        stat = path.stat()
        checksum = sha256_hex(raw.encode("utf-8"))
        previous_entry = previous.get(rel, {})
        created_ts = float(previous_entry.get("created_ts", stat.st_mtime))
        modified_ts = float(stat.st_mtime)
        tags = parse_tags(raw, config)
        note = Note(
            path=rel,
            abs_path=str(path.resolve()),
            filename=path.name,
            filename_stem=path.stem,
            title=title,
            lead=lead,
            body=body,
            raw_content=raw,
            word_count=len(raw.split()),
            tags=tags,
            metadata={},
            created_ts=created_ts,
            modified_ts=modified_ts,
            checksum=checksum,
            link=make_note_link(config, rel, title),
        )
        notes.append(note)
    note_map = {note.path: note for note in notes}
    title_map = {note.title: note for note in notes if note.title}
    for note in notes:
        parsed_links = parse_links(note.raw_content)
        note.links = []
        for title, href, link_type, is_external, rels, snippet, start, end in parsed_links:
            target_path = None
            if not is_external:
                target_path = resolve_link_target(note_map, title_map, href, title)
            note.links.append(
                Link(
                    title=title,
                    href=href,
                    type=link_type,
                    is_external=is_external,
                    rels=rels,
                    snippet=snippet,
                    snippet_start=start,
                    snippet_end=end,
                    source_path=note.path,
                    target_path=target_path,
                )
            )
    return notes


def normalize_rel_path(notebook: Notebook, raw_path: str) -> str:
    path = Path(raw_path)
    if path.is_absolute():
        try:
            return path.resolve().relative_to(notebook.root).as_posix()
        except Exception:
            return raw_path
    return raw_path.replace("\\", "/").strip("/")


def path_matches(note_path: str, raw_path: str) -> bool:
    if raw_path == "":
        return True
    candidate = raw_path.rstrip("/")
    return note_path == candidate or note_path.startswith(candidate + "/")


def parse_date_filter(value: str) -> dt.datetime:
    value = value.strip()
    if value == "today":
        now = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
        return dt.datetime(now.year, now.month, now.day, tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
    for fmt in (
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z",
        "%Y-%m-%d",
    ):
        try:
            parsed = dt.datetime.strptime(value, fmt)
            if parsed.tzinfo is None:
                parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
            return parsed.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    fail(f"invalid date {value!r}")


def note_titles_for_paths(notes: list[Note], paths: list[str]) -> set[str]:
    by_path = {note.path: note for note in notes}
    result = set()
    for raw_path in paths:
        for note in notes:
            if path_matches(note.path, raw_path):
                result.add(note.title)
    return result


def note_paths_for_paths(notes: list[Note], paths: list[str]) -> set[str]:
    result = set()
    for raw_path in paths:
        for note in notes:
            if path_matches(note.path, raw_path):
                result.add(note.path)
    return result


def graph_maps(notes: list[Note]) -> tuple[dict[str, set[str]], dict[str, set[str]]]:
    outgoing: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    incoming: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    for note in notes:
        for link in note.links:
            if link.target_path:
                outgoing[note.path].add(link.target_path)
                incoming[link.target_path].add(note.path)
    return outgoing, incoming


def related_paths(
    all_notes: list[Note], start_paths: set[str], max_distance: int, recursive: bool
) -> set[str]:
    outgoing, incoming = graph_maps(all_notes)
    frontier = set(start_paths)
    seen = set(start_paths)
    distance = 0
    while frontier and distance < max_distance:
        next_frontier = set()
        for path in frontier:
            next_frontier |= outgoing.get(path, set())
            next_frontier |= incoming.get(path, set())
        next_frontier -= seen
        seen |= next_frontier
        frontier = next_frontier
        distance += 1
        if not recursive:
            break
    return seen


def filter_notes(notes: list[Note], options: dict[str, Any], notebook: Notebook) -> list[Note]:
    result = list(notes)
    if options.get("paths"):
        path_filters = [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["paths"]]
        result = [
            note
            for note in result
            if any(path_matches(note.path, path_filter) for path_filter in path_filters)
        ]
    if options.get("exclude"):
        excludes = [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["exclude"]]
        result = [
            note
            for note in result
            if not any(path_matches(note.path, value) for value in excludes)
        ]
    if options.get("tag"):
        required = set(options["tag"])
        result = [note for note in result if required.issubset(set(note.tags))]
    if options.get("tagless"):
        result = [note for note in result if not note.tags]
    if options.get("match"):
        strategy = options.get("match_strategy", "fts")
        queries = options["match"]
        filtered = []
        for note in result:
            haystack = f"{note.title}\n{note.path}\n{note.raw_content}"
            ok = True
            for query in queries:
                if strategy == "re":
                    if not re.search(query, haystack, re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE):
                        ok = False
                        break
                elif strategy == "exact":
                    if query not in haystack:
                        ok = False
                        break
                else:
                    if query.lower() not in haystack.lower():
                        ok = False
                        break
            if ok:
                filtered.append(note)
        result = filtered
    all_notes = notes
    outgoing, incoming = graph_maps(all_notes)
    if options.get("mention"):
        titles = note_titles_for_paths(all_notes, [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["mention"]])
        result = [
            note
            for note in result
            if any(title and title in note.raw_content for title in titles)
        ]
    if options.get("mentioned_by"):
        source_notes = [
            note
            for note in all_notes
            if any(
                path_matches(note.path, normalize_rel_path(notebook, value))
                for value in options["mentioned_by"]
            )
        ]
        mentioned_titles: set[str] = set()
        for source in source_notes:
            for candidate in all_notes:
                if candidate.title and candidate.title in source.raw_content:
                    mentioned_titles.add(candidate.title)
        result = [note for note in result if note.title in mentioned_titles]
    if options.get("link_to"):
        targets = note_paths_for_paths(
            all_notes, [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["link_to"]]
        )
        result = [
            note
            for note in result
            if targets.intersection(outgoing.get(note.path, set()))
        ]
    if options.get("no_link_to"):
        targets = note_paths_for_paths(
            all_notes, [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["no_link_to"]]
        )
        result = [
            note
            for note in result
            if not targets.intersection(outgoing.get(note.path, set()))
        ]
    if options.get("linked_by"):
        sources = note_paths_for_paths(
            all_notes, [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["linked_by"]]
        )
        allowed = set()
        for source in sources:
            allowed |= outgoing.get(source, set())
        result = [note for note in result if note.path in allowed]
    if options.get("no_linked_by"):
        sources = note_paths_for_paths(
            all_notes, [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["no_linked_by"]]
        )
        blocked = set()
        for source in sources:
            blocked |= outgoing.get(source, set())
        result = [note for note in result if note.path not in blocked]
    if options.get("orphan"):
        result = [note for note in result if not incoming.get(note.path)]
    if options.get("missing_backlink"):
        missing = []
        for note in result:
            targets = outgoing.get(note.path, set())
            if any(note.path not in outgoing.get(target, set()) for target in targets):
                missing.append(note)
        result = missing
    if options.get("related"):
        start_paths = note_paths_for_paths(
            all_notes, [normalize_rel_path(notebook, value) for value in options["related"]]
        )
        max_distance = int(options.get("max_distance", 1))
        recursive = bool(options.get("recursive"))
        related = related_paths(all_notes, start_paths, max_distance, recursive)
        result = [note for note in result if note.path in related]
    for key, attr in (
        ("created", "created_ts"),
        ("modified", "modified_ts"),
    ):
        if options.get(key):
            target = parse_date_filter(options[key]).date()
            result = [
                note
                for note in result
                if dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(getattr(note, attr), tz=dt.timezone.utc).date() == target
            ]
        before = options.get(f"{key}_before")
        if before:
            target = parse_date_filter(before)
            result = [
                note
                for note in result
                if dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(getattr(note, attr), tz=dt.timezone.utc) < target
            ]
        after = options.get(f"{key}_after")
        if after:
            target = parse_date_filter(after)
            result = [
                note
                for note in result
                if dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(getattr(note, attr), tz=dt.timezone.utc) > target
            ]
    result = sort_notes(result, options.get("sort", []))
    limit = options.get("limit")
    if limit is not None:
        result = result[: int(limit)]
    return result


def sort_notes(notes: list[Note], terms: list[str]) -> list[Note]:
    if not terms:
        return sorted(notes, key=lambda note: note.path)
    result = list(notes)
    for term in reversed(terms):
        reverse = term.endswith("-")
        key = term[:-1] if reverse else term
        if key == "path":
            result.sort(key=lambda note: note.path, reverse=reverse)
        elif key == "title":
            result.sort(key=lambda note: note.title, reverse=reverse)
        elif key == "created":
            result.sort(key=lambda note: note.created_ts, reverse=reverse)
        elif key == "modified":
            result.sort(key=lambda note: note.modified_ts, reverse=reverse)
        elif key == "random":
            random.shuffle(result)
        else:
            result.sort(key=lambda note: getattr(note, "path"), reverse=reverse)
    return result


def sort_tags(tags: list[dict[str, Any]], terms: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not terms:
        return sorted(tags, key=lambda tag: tag["name"])
    result = list(tags)
    for term in reversed(terms):
        reverse = term.endswith("-")
        key = term[:-1] if reverse else term
        if key in ("name", "tag"):
            result.sort(key=lambda tag: tag["name"], reverse=reverse)
        elif key in ("count", "note-count"):
            result.sort(key=lambda tag: tag["noteCount"], reverse=reverse)
    return result


def format_custom_template(template: str, note: Note) -> str:
    return render_template(
        template,
        {
            "title": note.title,
            "path": note.path,
            "filename": note.filename,
            "filename_stem": note.filename_stem,
        },
    )


def render_note_text(note: Note, fmt: str) -> str:
    if fmt in ("default", "short"):
        return (
            f"{note.title} {note.path} ({relative_time(note.modified_ts)})\n\n"
            f"  \u2023 {note.lead}\n"
        )
    if fmt == "oneline":
        return f"{note.title} {note.path} ({relative_time(note.modified_ts)})"
    if fmt == "medium":
        return (
            f"{note.title} {note.path}\n"
            f"Created: {short_date(note.created_ts)}\n\n"
            f"  \u2023 {note.lead}\n"
        )
    if fmt == "long":
        return (
            f"{note.title} {note.path}\n"
            f"Created: {short_date(note.created_ts)}\n"
            f"Modified: {short_date(note.modified_ts)}\n\n"
            f"  \u2023 {note.lead}\n"
        )
    if fmt == "full":
        tags = ", ".join(note.tags)
        return (
            f"{note.title} {note.path}\n"
            f"Created: {short_date(note.created_ts)}\n"
            f"Modified: {short_date(note.modified_ts)}\n"
            f"Tags: {tags}\n\n"
            f"  {note.body}\n"
        )
    return format_custom_template(fmt, note)


def parse_global_flags(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[str]]:
    options: dict[str, Any] = {
        "working_dir": None,
        "notebook_dir": None,
        "no_input": False,
    }
    remaining: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        if arg in ("-h", "--help", "--version"):
            remaining.append(arg)
        elif arg == "--no-input":
            options["no_input"] = True
        elif arg.startswith("--working-dir="):
            options["working_dir"] = arg.split("=", 1)[1]
        elif arg == "-W":
            if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                fail("missing value for -W")
            options["working_dir"] = argv[i + 1]
            i += 1
        elif arg.startswith("-W") and arg != "-W":
            options["working_dir"] = arg[2:]
        elif arg.startswith("--notebook-dir="):
            options["notebook_dir"] = arg.split("=", 1)[1]
        elif arg == "--notebook-dir":
            if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                fail("missing value for --notebook-dir")
            options["notebook_dir"] = argv[i + 1]
            i += 1
        elif arg.startswith("-"):
            remaining.append(arg)
        else:
            remaining = argv[i:]
            return options, remaining
        i += 1
    return options, remaining


def parse_flag_value(argv: list[str], index: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
    if "=" in argv[index]:
        return argv[index].split("=", 1)[1], index
    if index + 1 >= len(argv):

def command_init(argv: list[str], global_opts: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    directory: str | None = None
    for arg in argv:
        if arg in ("-h", "--help"):
            return print_help(INIT_HELP)
        if arg.startswith("-"):
            if arg == "--no-input":
                continue
            if arg.startswith("--notebook-dir=") or arg.startswith("--working-dir="):
                continue
            if arg in ("--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"):
                continue
            fail(f"unknown flag {arg}")
        else:
            directory = arg
    base = Path(global_opts["working_dir"] or os.getcwd())
    target = (base / directory).resolve() if directory else base.resolve()
    if not global_opts["no_input"]:
        sys.stdout.write(INIT_PROMPT)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        try:
            answer = input()
        except EOFError:
            eprint("zk: error: EOF")
            return 1
        if answer.strip().lower().startswith("n"):
            config_text = DEFAULT_CONFIG.replace('link-format = "wiki"', 'link-format = "markdown"')
        else:
            config_text = DEFAULT_CONFIG
    else:
        config_text = DEFAULT_CONFIG
    (target / ".zk" / "templates").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (target / CONFIG_FILE).write_text(config_text, encoding="utf-8")
    (target / DB_FILE).write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    (target / TEMPLATE_FILE).write_text(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE, encoding="utf-8")
    return 0


def command_index(argv: list[str], global_opts: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    if any(arg in ("-h", "--help") for arg in argv):
        return print_help(INDEX_HELP)
    force = False
    verbose = False
    quiet = False
    for arg in argv:
        if arg in ("-f", "--force"):
            force = True
        elif arg in ("-v", "--verbose"):
            verbose = True
        elif arg in ("-q", "--quiet"):
            quiet = True
        elif arg == "--no-input":
            continue
        elif arg.startswith("--notebook-dir=") or arg.startswith("--working-dir="):
            continue
        elif arg in ("--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"):
            continue
        elif arg.startswith("-"):
            fail(f"unknown flag {arg}")
    working_dir = Path(global_opts["working_dir"] or os.getcwd())
    notebook = find_notebook(working_dir, global_opts["notebook_dir"])
    started = time.time()
    notes = scan_notes(notebook)
    old_notes = notebook.state.get("notes", {})
    current = {}
    added = []
    modified = []
    unchanged = []
    removed = sorted(set(old_notes) - {note.path for note in notes})
    for note in notes:
        previous = old_notes.get(note.path)
        current[note.path] = {
            "checksum": note.checksum,
            "created_ts": note.created_ts,
            "modified_ts": note.modified_ts,
        }
        if previous is None:
            added.append(note.path)
        elif force or previous.get("checksum") != note.checksum:
            modified.append(note.path)
        else:
            unchanged.append(note.path)
    notebook.state = {"notes": current}
    notebook.save_state()
    if quiet:
        return 0
    lines = []
    if verbose:
        for path in sorted(added):
            lines.append(f"+ added {path}")
        for path in sorted(modified):
            lines.append(f"~ modified {path}")
        for path in sorted(removed):
            lines.append(f"- removed {path}")
        for path in sorted(unchanged):
            lines.append(f"- unchanged {path}")
        if lines:
            sys.stdout.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n\n")
    duration = int(time.time() - started)
    sys.stdout.write(
        f"Indexed {len(notes)} notes in {duration}s\n"
        f"  + {len(added)} added\n"
        f"  ~ {len(modified)} modified\n"
        f"  - {len(removed)} removed\n"
    )
    return 0


def choose_group(config: dict[str, Any], directory_rel: str, explicit_group: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    groups = config.get("group", {})
    if explicit_group:
        group_cfg = groups.get(explicit_group, {})
        return explicit_group, group_cfg.get("note", {}), group_cfg.get("extra", {})
    directory_rel = directory_rel.strip("/")
    for name, group_cfg in groups.items():
        if not isinstance(group_cfg, dict):
            continue
        paths = group_cfg.get("paths", [name])
        if isinstance(paths, str):
            paths = [paths]
        for path in paths:
            candidate = str(path).strip("/")
            if directory_rel == candidate or directory_rel.startswith(candidate + "/"):
                return name, group_cfg.get("note", {}), group_cfg.get("extra", {})
    return None, {}, {}


def editor_command(config: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
    tool_cfg = config.get("tool", {})
    editor = tool_cfg.get("editor")
    if editor is not None:
        editor = str(editor)
        if editor == "":
            return None
        return editor
    return os.environ.get("EDITOR") or os.environ.get("VISUAL")


def parse_extra_pairs(value: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    result = {}
    for item in split_csv(value):
        if "=" in item:
            key, val = item.split("=", 1)
            result[key] = val
    return result

            pass

            i += 1
        elif arg.startswith("-"):
            fail(f"unknown flag {arg}")
        else:
            opts["directory"] = arg
        i += 1
    directory_rel = normalize_rel_path(notebook, opts["directory"] or "")
    directory_path = notebook.root / directory_rel
    group_name, group_note_cfg, group_extra = choose_group(config, directory_rel, opts.get("group"))
    note_cfg = dict(config.get("note", {}))
    note_cfg.update(group_note_cfg)
    extension = str(note_cfg.get("extension", "md")).lstrip(".")
    note_id = opts.get("id") or generate_id(config)
    title = opts.get("title") or str(note_cfg.get("default-title", "Untitled"))
    content_input = ""
    if opts["interactive"]:
        content_input = sys.stdin.read()
        content_input = content_input.rstrip("\n")
    filename_template = str(note_cfg.get("filename", "{{id}}"))
    filename_stem = render_template(
        filename_template,
        {
            "title": title,
            "id": note_id,
            "content": content_input,
            "extra": {**config.get("extra", {}), **group_extra, **opts["extra"]},
            "now": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc),
        },
    )
    note_path = directory_path / f"{filename_stem}.{extension}"
    template_name = opts.get("template") or note_cfg.get("template", "default.md")
    template_path = Path(str(template_name).replace("~", str(Path.home())))
    if not template_path.is_absolute():
        template_path = notebook.root / ".zk" / "templates" / str(template_name)
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    now = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    rendered = render_template(
        template,
        {
            "title": title,
            "id": note_id,
            "content": content_input,
            "extra": {**config.get("extra", {}), **group_extra, **opts["extra"]},
            "now": now,
            "date": parse_date_filter(opts["date"]) if opts.get("date") else now,
            "path": note_path.relative_to(notebook.root).as_posix(),
            "filename": note_path.name,
            "filename_stem": note_path.stem,
        },
    )
    if opts["dry_run"]:
        sys.stdout.write(rendered)
        if not rendered.endswith("\n"):
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
        eprint(str(note_path.resolve()))
        return 0
    note_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    note_path.write_text(rendered, encoding="utf-8")
    if opts["print_path"]:
        sys.stdout.write(str(note_path.resolve()) + "\n")
        return 0
    editor = editor_command(config)
    if not editor:
        eprint("zk: error: no editor set in config")
        return 1
    try:
        command = shlex.split(editor) + [str(note_path.resolve())]
        return subprocess.run(command).returncode
    except FileNotFoundError:
        eprint("zk: error: no editor set in config")
        return 1


def render_list_output(notes: list[Note], options: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    fmt = options.get("format", "default")
    header = options.get("header", "")
    footer = options.get("footer", "\n")
    delimiter = options.get("delimiter")
    if fmt == "json":
        body = compact_json([note.to_json() for note in notes])
    elif fmt == "jsonl":
        body = "\n".join(compact_json(note.to_json()) for note in notes)
    else:
        rendered = [render_note_text(note, fmt) for note in notes]
        if delimiter is None:
            if fmt in ("default", "short", "medium", "long", "full"):
                body = "\n".join(item.rstrip("\n") for item in rendered)
                if body:
                    body += "\n"
            else:
                body = "\n".join(rendered)
        else:
            stripped = [item.rstrip("\n") for item in rendered]
            body = delimiter.join(stripped)
            if body and delimiter != "\0":
                body += ""
    return f"{header}{body}{footer if footer is not None else ''}"

def render_graph(notes: list[Note], filtered: list[Note]) -> str:
    id_map = {note.path: index + 1 for index, note in enumerate(filtered)}
    links = []
    filtered_paths = set(id_map)
    for note in filtered:
        for link in note.links:
            if not link.target_path or link.target_path not in filtered_paths:
                continue
            link.source_id = id_map[note.path]
            link.target_id = id_map[link.target_path]
            links.append(link.to_json())
    note_lines = [compact_json(note.to_json()) for note in filtered]
    link_lines = [compact_json(link) for link in links]
    lines = ["{", '  "notes": [']
    for index, line in enumerate(note_lines):
        suffix = "," if index < len(note_lines) - 1 else ""
        lines.append(f"    {line}{suffix}")
    lines.append("  ],")
    lines.append('  "links": [')
    for index, line in enumerate(link_lines):
        suffix = "," if index < len(link_lines) - 1 else ""
        lines.append(f"    {line}{suffix}")
    lines.append("  ]")
    lines.append("}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def render_tag_output(tags: list[dict[str, Any]], options: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    fmt = options.get("format", "full")
    header = options.get("header", "")
    footer = options.get("footer", "\n")
    delimiter = options.get("delimiter")
    if fmt == "json":
        body = compact_json(tags)
    elif fmt == "jsonl":
        body = "\n".join(compact_json(tag) for tag in tags)
    elif fmt == "name":
        items = [tag["name"] for tag in tags]
        delim = "\n" if delimiter is None else delimiter
        body = delim.join(items)
        if body and delim != "\0":
            body += "\n"
    else:
        items = [f'{tag["name"]} ({tag["noteCount"]})' for tag in tags]
        delim = "\n" if delimiter is None else delimiter
        body = delim.join(items)
        if body and delim != "\0":
            body += "\n"
    return f"{header}{body}{footer if footer is not None else ''}"


def build_tags(notes: list[Note]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    counts: OrderedDict[str, int] = OrderedDict()
    for note in notes:
        for tag in note.tags:
            counts[tag] = counts.get(tag, 0) + 1
    tags = []
    for index, (name, count) in enumerate(counts.items(), start=1):
        tags.append(OrderedDict([("id", index), ("kind", "tag"), ("name", name), ("noteCount", count)]))
    return tags

    if not options.get("quiet"):
        eprint()
        eprint(plural_tag_summary(len(tags)))
    return 0


def command_tag(argv: list[str], global_opts: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    if any(arg in ("-h", "--help") for arg in argv):
        return print_help(TAG_HELP)
    cleaned = [
        arg
        for arg in argv
        if arg not in ("--no-input",)
        and not arg.startswith("--notebook-dir=")
        and not arg.startswith("--working-dir=")
    ]
    if cleaned and cleaned[0] == "list":
        return command_tag_list(argv[1:], global_opts)
    if cleaned and cleaned[0].startswith("-"):
        fail(f"unknown flag {cleaned[0]}")
    if cleaned and cleaned[0] not in ("list",):
        eprint(f"zk: error: unexpected argument {cleaned[0]}")
        return 1
    return command_tag_list(argv, global_opts)


def dispatch(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    global_opts, remaining = parse_global_flags(argv)
    if not remaining:
        return print_help(TOP_HELP)
    if remaining == ["--help"] or remaining == ["-h"]:
        return print_help(TOP_HELP)
    if remaining == ["--version"]:
        sys.stdout.write("zk dev\n")
        return 0
    if remaining[0] == "-V":
        eprint('zk: error: unknown flag -V, did you mean one of "-h", "-W"?')
        return 1
    if remaining[0].startswith("-"):
        eprint(f"zk: error: unknown flag {remaining[0]}")
        return 1
    command, args = remaining[0], remaining[1:]
    if command == "init":
        return command_init(args, global_opts)
    if command == "index":
        return command_index(args, global_opts)
    if command == "new":
        return command_new(args, global_opts)
    if command == "list":
        return command_list(args, global_opts)
    if command == "graph":
        return command_graph(args, global_opts)
    if command == "edit":
        return command_edit(args, global_opts)
    if command == "tag":
        return command_tag(args, global_opts)
    eprint(f"zk: error: unexpected argument {command}")
    return 1


def main() -> int:
    try:
        return dispatch(sys.argv[1:])
    except ZkError as err:
        eprint(f"zk: error: {err.message}")
        return err.exit_code
    except BrokenPipeError:
        return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
